verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same quantity, left unsimplified in the Lean. The Lean never writes the constants out: p2 f U p = X·n_s/(√(2X)·f) with f = (φ_*/C)·Φ(ΛX,η), and the endpoint value is carried as (4/Λ)·n/(√(2·(4/Λ))·f) (second_coordinate_large, line 904 onwards). Evaluating that is the display: (4/Λ)/√(8/Λ) = √(2/Λ) and f = φ_*Φ/C give |p₂| = C√(2/Λ)|n_s|/(φ_*Φ), so the factor C of the display is the Lean's division by C inside realAmplitude rather than an explicit multiplier, and φ_*Φ of the display is C·f. The surrounding argument differs in route: the paper bounds the denominator φ_*Φ from above and p₁ ≤ C₁ to get p₂²/p₁ > 2.3, whereas the Lean bounds 100Λ·f ≤ δ (angularField_small) and δ/2 < |n_s| and concludes (6/5)² < p₂² directly, then 9/4 < p₁ + p₂²/p₁ in CoefficientProfile.cone_at_four. The Lean's endpoint margin is 9/4 = 2.25 where the paper writes 2 + c_ex with c_ex = .2, i.e. 2.2.
